decision: The repeated zero-output pkexec guard authorization failure is the same fail-closed host authorization incident class, not a new device hazard. Run -06 is permanently closed and must never be resumed or reused. A fresh attended campaign may use the unchanged reviewed D1 closure only after an exact /usr/bin/pkexec /usr/bin/true probe exits zero, all guard processes and rules are absent, and a new manifest, approval, transaction directory, opening preflight, and live armed child-alive guard receipt are created.
new_campaign_conditions: Run -06 manifest, approval, intent, lock, journal, and transaction directory are never resumed or reused.
The operator confirms only the exact /usr/bin/pkexec /usr/bin/true probe; it must exit zero.
No pkexec setpriv guard process and no runtime or override guard rule may remain.
The new run uses a fresh ID, manifest, compatibility approval, absent transaction directory, and empty journal.
Opening preflight re-establishes exact A90 V3406 resident health, Phase 3 rootfs, absent work path, NCM, pstore, channel, rollback, recovery, and attendance.
A durable armed and child_alive=true live guard receipt precedes handoff intent.
Another zero-output null-returncode guard failure after a successful probe blocks further campaigns for host authorization repair.
re_review_trigger: Any execution-critical closure or reviewed semantic change, another guard authorization failure after successful preauthorization, or a new device hazard or incident.
